data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m); this comprises releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business, GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business and Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 16.6m (net of reinsurance), driven predominantly by releases in Third Party Liability (GBP 16.0m), with minor releases in Aviation (GBP 0.3m), Reinsurance acceptances (GBP 0.2m) and Other direct business (GBP 0.1m). No gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the movement note, so the reported GBP 16.6m is net of reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m)
this comprises releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business
GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business
Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m
prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year movement (gross 'Insurance liabilities' column) is provided in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note; the note reports only a net (after reinsurance) favourable development of GBP 16.6m, which has been used as a fallback. A gross claims development triangle is not available (the development table provided is explicitly 'net undiscounted ultimate claims'), so a gross PYD figure could not be determined. Prior-year development amounts in lob_movements are the line-level releases reported in the note and are net amounts.
